missing: A hub actually verified on an iPad Pro M4 doing all three at once — 4K60 external display, 10Gbps SSD transfers and 60W+ charging simultaneously — with the bandwidth tradeoff explained (DP alt-mode lanes vs USB data, Thunderbolt dock vs USB-C hub) and current prices.
why: Four of the twelve results are famous names on the wrong question (MacBook/Mac mini monitors, deals), two are unreadable, and Apple's support page explains capability without naming hubs. Macworld answers the iPad-hub question with specific picks (HDMI, 4K60, 100W passthrough) and Engadget covers hubs generally, so a new page would compete with one major reviewer answering in part. The rest are a niche site with unverifiable testing, a brand blog and a recycled-domain listicle. No source nails the M4-specific trio of monitor + SSD + charging at once, so a focused tested page could get in, but it is not an open field.
